newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen steady at noon, benchmark shift seen.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen steady at noon, benchmark shift seen.

text.p: The key three-month December Euroyen futures contract was steady by midday on Monday as sentiment was moderately bullish on the expectation the Bank of Japan's quarterly corporate sentiment survey due on Wednesday would show Japan's economic recovery was stalling once again.
The December contract is likely to lose its benchmark status from the night session on Monday, traders said.
The December was at 99.09 at noon, up from the 99.08 close on Friday.
The March was at 98.86, compared with 98.85 at Friday's settlement.
The BOJ's survey, known as the tankan, will be released at 8.50 a.m. on Wednesday (2350 GMT Tuesday).
Forecasts by economists polled by Reuters ranged from minus two to plus four for the June diffusion index for major manufacturers, and from minus three to minus 10 for major non-manufacturers.
The majority of the market expects the tankan to provide evidence that Japan's economic recovery is again stalling.
But any signs of an improvement in corporate sentiment would rattle the Euroyen market which has mostly priced in weak tankan results, traders said.
